terms.fr: Propositions de cause et de but

en.title: Clauses of cause and purpose
en.summary: A clause of cause says why something happened; a clause of purpose says why someone acts.

paragraphs: A clause of cause says why something happened. A clause of purpose says why someone does something.

items: He stayed home **because he was ill**.
I called **so that** you would know.
She saved money **to buy** a car.

paragraphs: Use because, since and as for reasons. Use to, in order to and so that for purposes. So that is followed by a clause, and to by a base verb.
